newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Mining Minister Teplizky dies at 65.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Mining Minister Teplizky dies at 65.

text.p: Chilean Mining Minister Benjamin Teplizky died early on Sunday of a heart attack at age 65, his family reported.
The death of the man responsible of Chile's mining policy took political circles by surprise, as he never complained of heart problems.

Teplizky was the only minister from the Radical Party in President Eduardo Frei's cabinet. As a member of a centre-left party, Teplizky was imprisoned and exiled under Augusto Pinochet's dictatorship.

"For me this is very painful, he was my brother, a companion of exile. We were together in Dawson Island and other jails during the military government," Senator Anselmo Sule, Radical Party president, said.
